introduction.description: Hello! I am a seasoned Frontend Developer with 1 year of commercial experience specializing in web application development. My technical prowess in React and TypeScript forms the foundation of my development expertise.

about.description: Booster Sewing is a web platform developed to automate processes in sewing workshops across Kyrgyzstan. The project supports multiple user roles with access control management.
about.generating: Generating orders based on those models
about.mobile: Synchronization with a mobile app where employees update order progress across stages (procurement, cutting, sewing, etc.)
about.status: Real-time order status updates for managers
about.statistics: A statistics page displaying data on stock, cutting, sewing, and shipping with date filters
about.warehouse: A raw materials warehouse with inventory management capabilities

responsibilities.title: ✅ Key Responsibilities
responsibilities.authentication: Implemented authentication via phone number, username, and password
responsibilities.models: Developed a complex page for creating and editing models with full business logic, including handling raw materials, colors, comments, and photos
responsibilities.kanban: Built a Kanban board for real-time order tracking. Visualized the production process split into stages: “Procurement → Warehouse Supervisor → Cutting → Production Director → Quality Control Department → Packaging → Finished Products” Each order moves between columns automatically depending on employee actions. For example, upon confirming a purchase, the order automatically moved to the next stage. This enabled users to track each order’s current stage, responsible personnel, and improved interdepartmental communication in real time.
responsibilities.employees: Developed an employee management interface and access control system. Implemented functionality for adding new employees via a modal form with fields: Full Name, phone number, email, country, city, and home address. After registration, users could:
responsibilities.optimized: Refactored and optimized legacy code: improved readability, sped up page loading and queries, and occasionally performed code reviews.

about.description: Booster Stock is a system for inventory management and tracking goods movement in a warehouse.
about.frontend: I was the sole Frontend Developer on the project and implemented all key modules from scratch.
about.sso: Set up SSO-based authentication and developed a full-fledged role-based access control system.
about.roles: Roles had specific limitations: for example, the “Finished Product” role could accept shipments, report surpluses and shortages, and the results were automatically forwarded to the warehouse.
about.info: I wrote structured code, created reusable components and custom hooks, and ensured the architecture was scalable and easy to read.
about.tasks: Other responsibilities were similar to those in the Sewing project.

learning.title: 🤝 Continuous Learning and Collaboration
learning.description: I am always striving for self-improvement and enhancement of my hard skills, so I make it a point to learn new technologies and tools as they emerge. I believe in the power of teamwork and am always ready to share my knowledge and experience with other developers. Together, we can create maintainable, high-quality, and efficient code that aligns with our team’s objectives.
